elements.element: The renewal mechanism must be either renewal only by mutual written agreement or automatic renewal subject to the preferred automatic-renewal safeguards.
elements.evidence: The clause uses the permitted automatic-renewal structure and includes the required term, opt-out, reminder, and pricing safeguards.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal term must be twelve (12) months.
elements.evidence: The clause states that each Service Option Attachment renews “for an additional term of twelve (12) months.”

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer must have the right to opt out of renewal.
elements.evidence: The clause permits “either party,” which includes Customer, to elect termination by written notice before renewal.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's required non-renewal notice period must be no more than thirty (30) days.
elements.evidence: Customer may prevent renewal by notifying IBM in writing at least thirty days before the current term ends, creating a 30-day advance-notice deadline.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must provide Customer with a renewal reminder.
elements.evidence: The clause affirmatively requires IBM to notify Customer in writing of each upcoming renewal.

elements.element: The Vendor renewal reminder must be provided at least sixty (60) days before renewal.
elements.evidence: IBM must provide the reminder “at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term.”

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must not exceed the applicable CPI increase.
elements.evidence: The clause caps renewal increases at the lesser of the U.S. Consumer Price Index increase and 3%, so the increase cannot exceed the CPI limb.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must not exceed three percent (3%).
elements.evidence: The clause caps renewal increases at the lesser of the CPI increase and 3% of then-current Charges.

elements.element: The fallback renewal structure may provide for automatic renewal.
elements.evidence: Each Service Option Attachment renews automatically.

elements.element: Under automatic renewal, Customer must have a right to prevent renewal by giving non-renewal notice.
elements.evidence: The clause allows either party, including Customer, to elect termination by written notice.

elements.element: The required non-renewal notice period must be no more than sixty (60) days.
elements.evidence: The clause requires only thirty days' advance notice, which is within the fallback maximum of sixty days.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must not exceed five percent (5%).
elements.evidence: The express cap is the lesser of the CPI increase and 3%, which necessarily does not exceed 5%.

result.reason: The redline fully implements the preferred automatic-renewal branch and therefore also satisfies the fallback. Its substantive changes are confined to the renewal duration, notice deadline, reminder obligation, and price cap. Unrelated commercial terms are not disturbed. Drafting quality is reduced because the CPI limb does not identify a particular CPI series or expressly state that the relevant measure is the percentage change, and it compares an undefined “increase” in an index with 3% of Charges; this creates avoidable dimensional and calculation ambiguity even though the intended cap is apparent.
